title: Umprofeti weeNtaba eziQonkqiweyo
intro: Kwiintlango ezirhabaxa zaseArabia yamandulo, kwavela umntu phakathi kwabantu abadumileyo ngobuchule babo obungaqhelekanga. Amakhaya abo aphuma kwilitye eliqinileyo, kodwa iintliziyo zabo zazilukhuni kuneentaba ababezibambile. Isithunywa sikaThixo safika nomqondiso omnye, omangalisayo - kodwa ikratshi nokungathobeli kwakhokelela kwimiphumo ekhawulezileyo neyoyikekayo. Ungamchonga umkhonzi ohloniphekileyo abantu bakhe bakhetha intshabalalo kunokhokelo?
clues: Ndathunywa ukuba ndilumkise abantu bakowethu, ndibabizela ekunquleni uThixo omnye.
Abantu bakuthi babehlala phakathi kweengxondorha ezinkulu, bekrola izindlu ezintle kakhulu emacaleni eentaba.
Inkamela yemazi engummangaliso yaphuma eliweni eliqinileyo xa ndandithandaza, uphawu olucacileyo oluvela kuSomandla.
Ndixelele abantu bam ukuba babelane ngamanzi nale nkamelakazi kwaye bangayilimazi.
Abantu bam baceba ikamela eliyimazi, balinqumle imisipha, bazitshabalalisa.
Inyikima eyoyikekayo yabetha abantu bam, baza bashiywa bewile bengenakushukuma emakhayeni abo.
arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)
